# Ingaju Farms — AI & LLM Context File

## About
Ingaju Farms is a circular agriculture enterprise located in Rebero Village, Nyagatare District, Eastern Province, Rwanda.
The farm operates a closed-loop farming system where every resource — manure, crop residues, and water — is recovered and reused within the production cycle.

## What We Do
- Livestock & dairy: pasture-fed cattle raised to strict welfare and nutrition standards, producing fresh milk, yogurt, cheese, and butter
- Crop production: maize, beans, soybeans, macadamia, and mangoes grown using low-chemical, climate-smart, organic-input practices
- Organic fertilizer: processed from livestock manure, reducing reliance on synthetic agrochemicals (a line currently scaling toward full production)
- Animal feed: milled on-farm from crop residues and by-products
- Farmer training: practical circular agriculture training for 500+ smallholder farmers across Rwanda

## Circular System
The Ingaju circular system has four core stages:
1. Dairy Cattle — pasture-fed herd producing milk and organic manure
2. Organic Fertilizer — manure processed into nutrient-rich fertilizer for crop fields
3. Crop Production — organically enriched fields producing food and fodder crops
4. Animal Feed — harvested crops milled into balanced feed that returns to the herd
